status_definitions.implemented: Production-path behavior exists with tests and no synthetic success fallback.
status_definitions.experimental: Executable prototype exists, but security, validity, or operations evidence is incomplete.
status_definitions.adapter_required: The domain contract exists but requires an approved provider or AXIOM adapter.
status_definitions.specified: The behavior is designed but not yet implemented.
status_definitions.disabled: The capability must not be represented as available in governed or release builds.

capabilities.summary: Flutter and Riverpod curriculum overview and detail screens read a schema-verified bundled SQLite curriculum database.
The current corpus deterministically produces 293 records across 21 courses, but upstream official-document digests, licensing review, and course-by-course human verification remain incomplete.

Canonical curriculum packs bind jurisdiction, authority, namespace, source and licence status, ingestion digest, uncalibrated heuristics, record and course digests, deterministic manifests, and external-key Ed25519 signatures; activation and authority review remain unavailable.

A digest-pinned education contract and transport-independent Dart client validate eight bounded AXIOM intent types, exact consent purposes, idempotency, digest fields, and fail-closed Gateway errors; no live transport or provider capsule is enabled.
The incomplete Phi-3 path fails closed and cannot return simulated output; a versioned tokenizer, bounded decoder, model digest, evaluation evidence, and approved AXIOM provider remain required.
Deterministic mathematics and science verification will run through a signed scientific-tool provider capsule.
Bounded image decoding and TFLite classification exist without mock equations, but no validated handwritten-math grammar, label map, or deterministic verifier is supplied.
Bounded stylus-signal preprocessing exists and fixed fallback scores were removed, but no validated scoring artifact is bundled or promoted.
The application-owned UDP/TCP mesh is disabled by default and only available as an explicitly keyed, bounded, AES-GCM development transport; it is not an identity or learner-record authority path.
Classroom synchronization will use admitted education nodes and AXIOM signed causal bundles rather than an application-owned authority path.
The current Hive student_data box is not an evidenced encrypted learner-record store and must not support governed learner data.
Learner events, preferences, accommodations, and progress will be encrypted, purpose-bound, revocable, selectively exportable, and human-appealable.
Legacy IRT-labelled values are exported only as visibly uncalibrated adaptation heuristics and are not psychometrically validated item-response parameters.
Learners will be able to export selected work, progress evidence, consent records, and provenance without unrelated private records.
Education credentials require the approved AXIOM SSI credential profile, issuer governance, revocation, and verification evidence.
Keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, text scaling, reduced-motion, stylus alternatives, and accessible export requirements are release gates.

non_claims: No current model binding provides a complete local tutor.
The current classroom mesh is not an AXIOM federation or secure production transport.
Local-first architecture alone does not establish legal or regulatory compliance.
Legacy difficulty and IRT-labelled values are uncalibrated heuristics, not validated psychometrics.
A valid pack signature proves integrity and signer possession, not Ministry approval, curriculum correctness, licensing permission, or safe activation.
The AXIOM education contract and client do not enable a provider, learner-record store, or network authority.
Installing an education capsule does not grant access to learner data.
